notes.title: Build 10 out now! Changelog:
notes.content:
Added 8 bit text font
 Fixed issue that caused trees to spawn over weapon icon
 Added a win condition for players who get to the late game (good luck, it's pretty much almost impossible)
 Added high score saving
 Miscellaneous bug fixes

notes.title: Build 9 Update Officially Out & Game Is Back Online!
notes.content:
Final Redoubt: Zombie Apocalypse is back online for all players after unforeseen technical difficulties, and now with Build 9! Thank you all for your support and patience while we dealt with the issue.

Change log:


 Updated death music. 
 Update rifle and axe mechanics. Rifle now temporarily increases the enemy spawn interval, and the axe requires charging up to swing.
 Added new difficulty settings: Easy, Hard, and a third secret setting.
 Added new weapons: crossbow, knife.
